drivingQuestion: Where on the neck may one slaughter, and where may one pinch a bird offering?
outcomeNote: A mishna stating law with no dispute and no named parties; the unit contains no act by one party upon another's words, so no interactions are emitted.

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַשּׁוֹחֵט מִן הַצְּדָדִין – שְׁחִיטָתוֹ כְּשֵׁרָה, הַמּוֹלֵק מִן הַצְּדָדִין – מְלִיקָתוֹ פְּסוּלָה. הַשּׁוֹחֵט מִן הָעוֹרֶף – שְׁחִיטָתוֹ פְּסוּלָה, הַמּוֹלֵק מִן הָעוֹרֶף – מְלִיקָתוֹ כְּשֵׁירָה. הַשּׁוֹחֵט מִן הַצַּוָּאר – שְׁחִיטָתוֹ כְּשֵׁרָה, הַמּוֹלֵק מִן הַצַּוָּאר – מְלִיקָתוֹ פְּסוּלָה, שֶׁכׇּל הָעוֹרֶף כָּשֵׁר לִמְלִיקָה, וְכׇל הַצַּוָּאר כָּשֵׁר לִשְׁחִיטָה. נִמְצָא, כָּשֵׁר בִּשְׁחִיטָה – פָּסוּל בִּמְלִיקָה, כָּשֵׁר בִּמְלִיקָה – פָּסוּל בִּשְׁחִיטָה.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «One who slaughters from the sides» of the throat, «his slaughter is valid. One who pinches» the neck of a bird offering «from the sides, his pinching is not valid.One who slaughters from the nape [oref]» of the neck, «his slaughter is not valid. One who pinches» a bird offering «from the nape» of the neck, «his pinching is valid. One who slaughters from the throat, his slaughter is valid. One who pinches» a bird offering «from the throat, his pinching is not valid, as the entire nape is valid for pinching and the entire throat is valid for slaughter. It is found that» that which is «valid for slaughter» is «not valid for pinching» and that which is «valid for pinching» is «not valid for slaughter.»

moves.summary: Slaughter from the sides of the neck is valid, while pinching from the sides is invalid
Slaughter from the nape is invalid, while pinching from the nape is valid
Slaughter from the throat is valid, while pinching from the throat is invalid

moves.cueHe: שכל העורף כשר למליקה, וכל הצואר כשר לשחיטה
moves.summary: The mishna supplies the rationale of the three paired rules: the whole nape belongs to pinching and the whole throat to slaughter
The mishna draws the general corollary that what is valid for slaughter is invalid for pinching and vice versa
